title: The open dashboard shows a newly filed item, and a stage change, within seconds without a reload
description: A real browser holds the dashboard open against a real control plane and temporary Postgres with a ledger of settled deliveries, over a 2 Mbit/s link. An item filed through the CLI appears on the Work and Now pages within 10 seconds, and releasing it moves it out of Backlog within 10 seconds, with no page reload: each poll carries the open items and only the settled summaries that changed.

steps.name: file and release an item while the dashboard is open
